steps.title: Save an extension whose manifest adds a Sync button to the titlebar
cmux: clear; D="${CMUX_CUSTOMIZE_DIR:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/cmux/customize}"; mkdir -p "$D" && echo  | base64 -d > "$D/main.js" && echo  | base64 -d > "$D/catalog.json" && echo  | base64 -d > "$D/cmux-app.json" && echo saved the toolbar button

steps.title: Pointer over the top row: the band's buttons show
The Sync button after Back and Forward, the built-in buttons' size
Run the button's op as a click does (apps-run): the extension's toast
steps.optional: a before app built before #47325 has no toolbar items, so the op is not there to run

steps.title: Save the manifest with a second button: no relaunch
cmux: clear; D="${CMUX_CUSTOMIZE_DIR:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/cmux/customize}"; mkdir -p "$D" && echo  | base64 -d > "$D/cmux-app.json" && echo saved a second button

steps.title: Pointer over the top row: the band's buttons show
Both buttons drawn from the saved manifest
